Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class DealService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.DealService
public class DealService extends Object
Seller offer/request/claim management. Each write commits the deal, listing, and recipient notifications together or rolls them all back.

    • acceptOffer

      public void acceptOffer(User seller, String dealId, long expectedVersion) throws SQLException
      Accepts a Pending proposal as the seller; accepting a seller's counter is the buyer's action.

      The deal is locked and must belong to the active seller at the expected version. A borrowing request whose period has expired cannot be accepted. The deal becomes Accepted, the Live listing is reserved, competing open proposals are cancelled with their buyers notified, and the buyer receives an "Offer Accepted" notification. All writes commit together or roll back together.

      Parameters:
      seller - the signed-in seller
      dealId - the deal identifier
      expectedVersion - the row version shown to the seller
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the seller identity or version is invalid, the deal is not Pending or has changed, a borrowing period expired, the listing is no longer available, or another deal was already accepted
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • declineOffer

      public void declineOffer(User seller, String dealId, long expectedVersion) throws SQLException
      Declines a Pending or Countered proposal as the seller.

      The deal is locked at the expected version, changed to Declined, and the buyer is notified in the same transaction.

      Parameters:
      seller - the signed-in seller who owns the deal
      dealId - the deal identifier
      expectedVersion - the row version shown to the seller
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the seller identity or version is invalid, the deal is missing or not owned, the proposal is not Pending or Countered, or it changed concurrently
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • counterOffer

      public void counterOffer(User seller, String dealId, long expectedVersion, Double counterPrice, LocalDateTime counterStart, LocalDateTime counterEnd) throws SQLException
      Counters a Pending or Countered proposal as the seller.

      A sale counter requires a price and no borrowing dates; a borrowing counter requires a start and an end at least five seconds later and no price. Giveaway claims cannot be countered. The deal becomes Countered with the new terms and the buyer is notified in the same transaction.

      Parameters:
      seller - the signed-in seller who owns the deal
      dealId - the deal identifier
      expectedVersion - the row version shown to the seller
      counterPrice - the counter sale price, or null for borrowing counters
      counterStart - the counter borrowing start, or null for sale counters
      counterEnd - the counter borrowing end, or null for sale counters
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the seller identity or version is invalid, the proposal is not open, the terms are invalid, the counter period expired, the deal is a giveaway claim, or the proposal changed concurrently
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back
